svg.title: Hadoop service-based architecture
svg.desc: Service-based architecture for Hadoop: five coarse-grained independently deployable daemon processes — NameNode (HDFS namespace), DataNode (block storage), ResourceManager (cluster scheduling), NodeManager (container management), and MapReduce ApplicationMaster (job coordination) — communicating via Protobuf-based IPC.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do clients submit jobs and access data in Hadoop?')
sendPrompt('What does the Hadoop NameNode manage?')
sendPrompt('What does BlockManager do inside the NameNode?')
sendPrompt('What does DatanodeManager do inside the NameNode?')
sendPrompt('What does a Hadoop DataNode do?')
g.text: Stores actual blocks on local disk

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the Hadoop ResourceManager do?')
sendPrompt('How does the YARN Scheduler allocate resources?')
sendPrompt('What does the ApplicationsManager do in YARN?')
sendPrompt('What does the Hadoop NodeManager do?')
sendPrompt('What does the MapReduce ApplicationMaster coordinate?')
g.text: Coordinates job execution · requests containers from RM · tracks map and reduce tasks

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does Hadoop RPC.java implement the Protobuf-based IPC layer?')
g.text: hadoop-common-project/…/ipc/RPC.java — each service exposes its own protocol surface

svg.text: Each daemon: separately deployed · separately started · own IPC protocol surface — not microservices, not a monolith
